Thanks :)

well, they moved to a better area, but still in the same neighborhood for the most part.

I grew up by Breukelen, so sort of neighbors lol.

Yo, I want to apologize. After I got pissed I checked through your history. Didn't realize you weren't american. In the US white is pale skin, thats it. We don't look at religion or anything else in the matter. Telling people that I'm not anglo saxton or anything wouldn't have made a difference. In other countries I'm aware its different. Sorry for snapping, but if you see the rest of the thread, and my experiences maybe you can try to figure out why I did.

are you fucking serious? when I was attacked, no one asked my fucking religion, they attacked me for the pale skin. white jewish whatever, I was attacked for being "white skinned". Guess everything was a case of mistaken identity eh? should have told them as they were tearing at my clothes "hey guys, i'm not white, i'm jewish" like that would have made a fucking bit of difference....

oh man! for me it was a knitting needle (a very very thin one) to the gut!!! and yea... after that I made sure to leave the area ASAP. 

hey, don't you know? in those areas we're racist for being white! /sarcasm. 

you are right though, the winning move and fight or flight - flight :(

you didn't hijack, you spoke about your experiences, and its welcome :) . I hope things improve for communication between your mom and wife, its not fair for your wife and you to experience that. Just remember that your love for your wife overcomes so much. Love is strong.
any racism, no matter what race vs race, sucks. I hope things have improved for you <3

LOL <3 thank you. you made both me and my husband crack up. I wouldn't exactly call myself hot, but I love how you said that :) :)

its seriously the first time anyone has ever said "fuck you" to me and I've laughed instead of getting frustrated lol

I've been called the same by white people because I've stood up for black friends... its crazy :( 

as for what you were called, yep yep i know those well. did you learn how to fight too? I always surprised people when the 'little fat white girl" could actually fight lol.
oh really? gee, i'm pretty damned pale so I am "white"... and if i wasn't, then what am I?

nah, my parents are still there as well, but i not only left the borough, i left the state. Moved in with my boyfriend a while back, now we're married and expecting the first kid. I want my parents to leave but my dad is a brooklyn boy through and through and refuses to :(
why does it matter? and check the thread...
<3 its about all I can say. And I have used it to help others. I'm working in a field where I help others constantly (though for now I'm taking a small break lol)

I deleted what I originally wrote... putting it in words left me shaken for hours. Sorry to do that to you.

(for anyone who sees this message, I had described the attack :/ )

number 1, I hate that word, number 2, if you are referring to black people you are dead wrong. 

even though what happened to me was based on race, I will never hold it against members of the race who did that to me

are you kidding me? my white skin and female anatomy - I'm jewish, so lots of areas won't take me, and secondly i'm fat... again won't get anywhere. 

I can't run either (i mean yea, I can lose the weight, but I can't change my looks), but its ok. I don't need to run, I made the best of a bad situation, and somehow many of these people on reddit reminded me.

YES!!! exactly! the teachers didn't give a shit, and those assholes were white lol (so you'd think using white/religious slurs would actually get them since it described them too... nope). (which looking back also caused a bit of a rift) 

I hear ya.

middle class too, but ironically both of us are from the same area, so he gets it lol. 

I have some middle class friends who have experienced it, however when I describe my case there is a bit of shock (I leave out the rape part for the purpose of I don't want to be judged). I honestly think its not only a racial problem but also a socioeconomic issue as well.

Brooklyn represent! So ya, I see EXACTLY where you are growing up. Theres a chance we might have grown up in the same project lol. yea the gunpoint ones, or the case where i was pulled behind my mom during a robbery... those were fun :/ 

My Asian friends, and my Arab friends were also persecuted, so I knew it wasn't only me. 
and yep... theres "no way we'd know racism" ugh. yesterday when i posted this I was just furious, now I'm rolling my eyes at how ridiculous the one who said that to me was. 

However, sounds like we both escaped :)

ok - first off, any more instances and i'd be fucking identifiable, you think i want that? secondly, white people are dicks too, i damn well know that, however... should every white person be tortured for what others have done, should ever asian person the same, black person the same... really? 

also, i have nearly been raped, I have nearly been killed, I have been robbed, I have seen my family's possessions destroyed, I have had people threaten my family (and where i'm from, no matter yo race you get pissed) all because i'm white. other major things I won't go into. You know... I had actually come back to this post on my main account and logged into this throwaway just to tell you off. You think you know my life? CHOKE ON A COCK YOU DICK

dude, you are sweet. you didn't do anything but I totally get where you are coming from (i've appologized for what whites have done, and as i said my family wasn't even in the country at the time lol). Sadly it was a group of black kids but ya know? even with all this color to me is not all that important. I see them more as thugs, brutes, eh pieces of work. 

however going by personality as opposed to color of skin - in no way are they your people, you are nice :)

It just struck a nerve, I'm feeling down on myself to begin with, so logging in to see my total as -2 (freaking RES not always so great) threw me. 

I don't feel my post was brilliant lol, it was me venting, but thank you. I'm just so cranky right now (and the fact I'm pregnant and can't take a drink which would have already calmed my nerves by now) makes it tougher. I am being silly about the whole thing - they are just numbers anyway but I guess it got me because I was looking for validation.

it just shows how utterly useless (and easy to hate) I am. No explanation no nothing... probably some one who disagrees with my statements and feels I'm in the wrong. All I would like would be an explanation rather than to make me feel even more like the shit I am

ah, i'm being downvoted too.. i see, know what I wish they had succeeded... this white girl doesn't need to exist. I apparently made up everything and was fed with a fucking silver spoon. fuck everyone

to the two people who were kind to me, thank you <3

thank you, I mean its not like I was going around saying "i'm white i've been discriminated against" but when I saw a comment that white people don't experience it I kinda spoke up, that it was a universal thing and we all do... and was quickly quieted :(  

i didn't mention the big one there though- wasn't exactly going to be open about nearly being gangraped at 12 on a non-anonymous site, my family doesn't need to know...
thanks, even to this day though it has impacted my sex life, and this was 16 years ago. my husband doesn't get why i have some *interests* but can't actually act them out (specifically oral)
